content_sections.heading: CNCI Promotion Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy table on page 1 of the circular shows 11 unreserved vacancies and one ST vacancy. The ST vacancy is available under the Nursing Sister post.

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility and required experience will be calculated as of 31 July 2026. Applicants must also satisfy all conditions prescribed in the applicable CNCI Recruitment Rules.

Graduate in Science with Honours in the respective field and Junior Scientific Assistant with five years of service in the grade

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The promotion process will be conducted through selection by the Departmental Promotion Committee. Selection will follow the CNCI Recruitment Rules and relevant Government of India regulations. Merely satisfying the eligibility requirements does not guarantee promotion. The Departmental Promotion Committee will examine the employee’s eligibility, service details, experience and submitted documents.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CNCI Internal Promotion 2026
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed internal promotion application form. Select the post for which promotion is sought. Enter the employee’s name, employee code, category and current designation. Provide the date of appointment in the current post and the date of joining CNCI. Enter the initial and present pay levels. Provide the number of years of service in the current post. Enter the date of the last promotion, if applicable. Provide details of qualifications acquired during service at CNCI. Attach all necessary supporting documents. Sign the declaration and submit the hard copy through the Head of Department or Section. Ensure that the forwarded application reaches the Director, CNCI, by 30 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Application Address
content_sections.text: The Director Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute Kolkata, West Bengal The application must be submitted through the applicant’s respective Section Head or Head of Department.

content_sections.heading: Details Required in the Application Form
content_sections.text: Post applied for Name of the employee Employee code Category Current designation or post Date of appointment in the current post Department or section Date of joining the institute Initial pay level Present pay level Years of service in the present post Date of last promotion, if any Educational or professional qualifications acquired during service at CNCI Recommendation of the forwarding authority

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This promotion circular is only for eligible serving employees of CNCI. Applications from outside candidates will not be considered. Employees should carefully check the qualification and feeder-grade experience requirements. Eligibility and experience will be calculated as of 31 July 2026. The application must be submitted in the prescribed format. All required supporting documents must be attached. The application must be recommended and forwarded by the Head of Department or Section. Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents will be rejected. Candidates who do not satisfy the applicable Recruitment Rules will not be considered. CNCI may decide not to fill any advertised post due to administrative requirements. The decision of the competent authority will be final in case of any dispute or ambiguity.

faq.question: Q1. How many promotion vacancies are available at CNCI?
faq.answer: A total of 12 internal promotion vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. Can outside candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: No. Only eligible serving employees of Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the hard-copy application is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility cut-off date?
faq.answer: Eligibility and experience will be calculated as of 31 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which post has the highest pay level?
faq.answer: The Assistant Nursing Superintendent post carries the highest pay level, which is Level 10 under the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for promotion to Assistant Nursing Superintendent?
faq.answer: The employee must be a Nursing Sister with five years of regular service in the grade.
